test_title: PYST 39: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some movies are dramas.

No drama is a comedy.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some movies are comedies.

II. All movies can never be comedies.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statements:

Some movies are dramas.

No drama is a comedy.

__**Venn Diagram:**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1650a559058fff9c1669df9edb3035ebfa25d7427956a34519e572cc1c2e761.png] **__

__**Conclusions:**__

I. Some movies are comedies.→ **False **(It is possible but not defined)

II. All movies can never be comedies.→ **True **(Some movies are dramas, and drama can not be comedy)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows.**"
